title: Risk assessment of mercury and lead in fish species from Iranian international wetlands
author: Zolfaghari
materials: There are four steps in this method [5,6]:

steps.title: Grind samples to powder
steps.instruction: Grind the dried fish samples into a homogeneous powder.

steps.title: Measure mercury with AMA
steps.instruction: Determine total mercury concentration using the Advanced Mercury Analyzer (LECO AMA 254) according to ASTM standard D‑6722, analyzing each sample in triplicate.

steps.title: Measure lead by graphite furnace AAS
steps.instruction: Analyze lead content with an atomic absorption spectrometer equipped with a graphite furnace (GBC GF 3000) by injecting 20 µL of the sample into the device.

steps.title: Conduct EPA/WHO health risk assessment
steps.instruction: Apply the EPA/WHO health risk assessment method, which consists of four steps, to evaluate the risk associated with the measured mercury and lead levels.
